title: Week x AI topic x community category: what the AI community publishes about the topic
description: crosssource/community.py from public feeds and APIs (HF daily papers and model releases, lab and practitioner newsletters, AI Engineer and YC YouTube, YC Requests for Startups, The Batch, AI safety and critic organisations), matched to contracts/ai_lexicon.yaml -> lake/gold/community_topic_weekly.parquet. A separate, unvalidated signal: most feeds keep a short history, so it never enters the backtest. Item titles stay in lake/raw/community, never in git.

n_items.description: items of the week matching the topic

score.description: summed public engagement where the source gives one (HF upvotes or likes), else 0
